data.task_title: Load and Analyze Pipeline Execution Data

features.title: Identify Optimization Opportunities
features.description: Implement functionality to identify potential optimization opportunities based on analysis.
acceptance_criteria: System highlights areas for performance improvement
Recommendations are based on data-driven insights
Users receive alerts for critical optimization opportunities

features.title: Analyze Execution Metrics
features.description: Create a system to analyze execution metrics from the loaded pipeline data.
acceptance_criteria: Analysis results are stored for further use
System can handle large datasets efficiently

features.title: Generate Performance Visualizations
features.description: Develop visualizations to represent pipeline performance trends and metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Visualizations include execution times and stage success rates
Users can export visualizations for reporting purposes

features.title: Load Pipeline Execution Data
features.description: Develop functionality to load execution data from the Artemis pipeline for analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Data is loaded from the pipeline into the analysis system
Data loading process is automated and scheduled
Error handling is implemented for data loading failures
